answer: Grow or freeze: each node tends a thread, a hash-chained log extended each epoch by a three-GPU-hour memory-hard checkpoint; links build on links, so ten fakes burn thirty hours, not three. Two rotating witnesses co-sign each checkpoint onto the node's crystal, replayable by anyone. Joining freezes 30 POA in tundra escrow; a gap or forged link cracks the crystal — 30 POA burned, thread severed, node iced two epochs. Limits: it prices compute, not whales; GPU rentals erode it. N fakes × 30 POA = 30N POA forfeited.
